rationale: The shaft, broad capital, stepped foot and green bands remain readable in individual and reduced views.
The six rendered instances sit coherently among the actual neighboring static models, with no visible collision or contact defect.
No concrete placed-scale improvement was established that would justify changing the baseline.

independent_review.scope: Six exact Object37 placements and the supplied individual, normal, reduced and reverse views.
independent_review.limits: The review does not claim visual inspection of all 112 placements, a terrain render or a game-client test.
